comments:
The nickname "chos tsha ba" is explained in [WBWSEPQX]: 4b (lar mtshan nyid kyi grwa sar lo mang du bzhugs te | khams pa yar 'dug pa la chos tsha ba'i grags pa thob).
Sho sgom (ID:3857), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855) and Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856) are known as the "grub thob mi gsum" and as the "khams pa mi gsum."
